free_text: Although the patient has a prior positive biopsy, the evidence strongly suggests proceeding with biopsy due to the significant PSA velocity of 1.13 ng/mL/yr and the rising trend to 9.0 ng/mL. The retrieved PSA trend data and the mpMRI showing a PI-RADS 4 lesion provide the necessary clinical impetus to re-sample, as no documented prior grade or treatment pathway was established. The statistical prior suggested deferral, but the retrieved evidence of active disease progression overrides this initial suggestion.
